methods.name: 10x Chromium 5' Gene Expression
methods.summary: 5' transcript profiling with a universal RT primer and barcoded template-switching oligos on the gel beads, so reads start at the transcript 5' end.

methods.name: 10x Chromium 5' Immune Profiling Feature Barcoding
methods.summary: 5' gene expression plus antibody-oligo surface protein tags in one droplet workflow, with V(D)J receptor libraries from the same cells.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Flex (Fixed RNA Profiling)
methods.aliases: Flex Gene Expression; Fixed RNA Profiling
methods.summary: Probe-based single-cell gene expression assay in which RNA probes hybridize to RNA in fixed cells or nuclei before droplet partitioning, with Cell Ranger analysis.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Feature Barcoding
methods.summary: Antibody-oligo tags captured on the same gel beads as mRNA, giving surface-protein counts per droplet alongside transcriptomes.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Gene Expression
methods.summary: Droplet 3' mRNA counting where gel beads carry cell-barcoded, UMI-tagged oligo-dT primers co-encapsulated with each cell.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Solution v1
methods.title: Massively parallel digital transcriptional profiling of single cells
methods.summary: First commercial droplet 3' transcriptome kit, using barcoded gel beads and a microfluidic GemCode device to profile tens of thousands of cells per run.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell ATAC
methods.title: Massively parallel single-cell chromatin landscapes of human immune cell development and intratumoral T cell exhaustion
methods.summary: Droplet-based scATAC-seq in which nuclei are tagmented in bulk first, then each tagged nucleus is barcoded in a droplet.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression
methods.summary: Tn5 tagmentation of nuclei followed by droplet capture of tagged open-chromatin DNA and mRNA on the same beads, giving accessibility and expression per nucleus.

methods.name: 10x Visium
methods.summary: Commercial spatial gene expression assay that captures polyadenylated RNA from tissue sections on barcoded spots on a slide.

methods.name: 10x Visium HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
methods.aliases: Visium HD 3'; HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
methods.summary: Poly(A)-based whole-transcriptome spatial gene expression assay on fresh frozen tissue, run with the Visium CytAssist instrument.

methods.name: 10x Xenium In Situ
methods.summary: Imaging-based in situ platform mapping hundreds of RNA targets at subcellular resolution in tissue sections using the Xenium Analyzer.

methods.name: 2C-RT
methods.title: 2C-RT Quantifies Genome-Wide DNA Replication Perturbations and Redefines RIF1-CDC7 Regulation of Replication Timing
methods.summary: Replication timing from EdU-labelled S-phase cells sorted by a cell-cycle marker and DNA content, with multiplexed EdU-seq.

methods.name: 2cChIP-seq
methods.title: 2cChIP-seq and 2cMeDIP-seq: The Carrier-Assisted Methods for Epigenomic Profiling of Small Cell Numbers or Single Cells
methods.summary: Carrier-assisted ChIP-seq that adds modified-histone mimics and dUTP-containing DNA carriers to recover histone-mark profiles from 10-1000 cells.

methods.name: 2cMeDIP-seq
methods.title: 2cChIP-seq and 2cMeDIP-seq: The Carrier-Assisted Methods for Epigenomic Profiling of Small Cell Numbers or Single Cells
methods.summary: Carrier-assisted MeDIP-seq that uses methylated mimic and dUTP-DNA carriers to profile DNA methylation from as few as 10-1000 cells.

methods.name: 3'-seq
methods.title: Ubiquitously transcribed genes use alternative polyadenylation to achieve tissue-specific expression
methods.summary: 3' end RNA sequencing method that maps transcript 3' ends across tissues to quantify alternative polyadenylation.

methods.name: 3'Pool-seq
methods.title: 3'Pool-seq: an optimized cost-efficient and scalable method of whole-transcriptome gene expression profiling
methods.summary: Low-cost 3'-end-focused bulk RNA-seq with dual-indexed pooling in 96-well plates and tagmentation.

methods.name: 3'Ribo-seq
methods.title: Large-scale translatome profiling annotates the functional genome and reveals the key role of genic 3' untranslated regions in translatomic variation in plants
methods.summary: Plant translatome profiling that combines polysome profiling, 3' selection and barcoded pooling.

methods.name: 3'T-fill
methods.title: An efficient method for genome-wide polyadenylation site mapping and RNA quantification
methods.summary: Poly(A) stretches are filled in with unlabeled dTTP so sequencing starts right after the tail into the 3'UTR, mapping polyadenylation sites and quantifying RNA.

methods.name: 3AIM-seq
methods.title: 3AIM-seq: Quality assessment of mRNA therapeutics using sequencing for 3' poly(A) tails of in vitro-transcribed mRNA
methods.summary: Ligation-free adapter and 3' end amplification library prep with a dedicated algorithm to measure poly(A) tail length and sequence of in vitro-transcribed mRNA therapeutics.

methods.name: 3C
methods.title: Capturing chromosome conformation
methods.summary: Chromosome conformation capture: crosslink, digest and ligate, then quantify ligation between chosen loci. The ancestor of the C-family.

methods.name: 3D Genome Browser
methods.title: The 3D Genome Browser: a web-based browser for visualizing 3D genome organization and long-range chromatin interactions.
methods.summary: Web browser for visualising Hi-C and other chromatin-interaction data alongside linked regulatory tracks.

methods.name: 3dPCR
methods.title: Sequence specific sorting of DNA molecules with FACS using 3dPCR
methods.summary: PCR-based sequence-specific FACS sorting of DNA molecules that enriches rare long targets for deep sequencing from heterogeneous DNA populations.

methods.name: 3t-seq
methods.title: 3t-seq: automatic gene expression analysis of single-copy genes, transposable elements, and tRNAs from RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Automatic RNA-seq analysis that jointly quantifies single-copy genes, transposable elements and tRNAs.

methods.name: 454 pyrosequencing
methods.title: Genome sequencing in microfabricated high-density picolitre reactors
methods.summary: Highly parallel sequencing-by-synthesis in picolitre fibre-optic wells with emulsion PCR amplification and pyrosequencing readout, demonstrated by shotgun sequencing of a bacterial genome.

methods.name: 4C-seq
methods.title: Robust 4C-seq data analysis to screen for regulatory DNA interactions
methods.summary: Inverse-PCR from a single viewpoint to sequence all of its ligation partners (one-vs-all).

methods.name: 4Cin
methods.title: 4Cin: A computational pipeline for 3D genome modeling and virtual Hi-C analyses from 4C data
methods.summary: Builds 3D models and virtual Hi-C maps of a genomic locus from a few 4C-seq or Capture-C-like experiments.

methods.name: 5'RNA-Seq
methods.title: 5'RNA-Seq identifies Fhl1 as a genetic modifier in cardiomyopathy
methods.summary: Transcriptome sequencing strategy that detects genome-wide changes in 5' transcription start-site usage.

methods.name: 5C
methods.title: Chromosome Conformation Capture Carbon Copy (5C): a massively parallel solution for mapping interactions between genomic elements
methods.summary: 3C library read out with multiplexed ligation-mediated amplification of many primer pairs, mapping all contacts among chosen loci.

methods.name: 5FU-seq
methods.title: Fluorouridine labeling enables spatiotemporal mapping of transcriptomes and enhancers in vivo
methods.summary: Transient 5-fluorouridine labelling that maps nascent transcripts in mouse tissue, and in a transgenic line also active enhancers.

methods.name: 5hmC-SMRT
methods.title: Sensitive and specific single-molecule sequencing of 5-hydroxymethylcytosine
methods.summary: Chemically labels 5-hydroxymethylcytosine for affinity enrichment and kinetic signal enhancement, then reads strand-specific, base-resolution 5hmC on PacBio SMRT sequencing.

methods.name: 5PSeq Explorer
methods.title: 5PSeq Explorer: interactive analysis of co-translational mRNA decay and ribosome dynamics
methods.summary: Web and Docker platform for interactive exploration of 773 uniformly processed 5PSeq datasets across 23 species.

methods.name: 5XP-seq
methods.title: 5´XP sRNA-seq: efficient identification of transcripts with and without 5´ phosphorylation reveals evolutionary conserved small RNA
methods.summary: Small-RNA library prep that tags 5'-phosphorylated RNAs while remaining open to all 5'-terminal modifications, separating 5'P from other small RNAs.

methods.name: 6-base-CUT&Tag
methods.title: Sequencing DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation at co-occurring chromatin features
methods.summary: CUT&Tag-based method that sequences 5mC and 5hmC simultaneously at target chromatin features such as histone modifications.

methods.name: A2Sign
methods.title: A2Sign: Agnostic Algorithms for Signatures-a universal method for identifying molecular signatures from transcriptomic datasets prior to cell-type deconvolution
methods.summary: Non-negative tensor factorization approach that derives cell-type molecular signatures from bulk transcriptomic data without prior cell-type knowledge, ahead of deconvolution.

methods.name: a6A-seq
methods.title: a6A-seq: N 6-allyladenosine-based cellular messenger RNA metabolic labelling and sequencing
methods.summary: Metabolic labelling of mRNA with N6-allyladenosine; iodination makes cyclized A that causes RT misincorporation, so labelled RNA is detected by mutation without pull-down.

methods.name: AAB-seq
methods.title: Rapid discovery of monoclonal antibodies via high-throughput single BCR affinity sequencing
methods.summary: Single-cell BCR sequencing that pairs heavy and light chains with a DNA-barcoded antigen-binding affinity score.

methods.name: AAnet
methods.title: AAnet Resolves a Continuum of Spatially Localized Cell States to Unveil Intratumoral Heterogeneity
methods.summary: Neural network that learns archetypal states along a phenotypic continuum in single-cell data.

methods.name: AASRA
methods.title: AASRA: an anchor alignment-based small RNA annotation pipeline†
methods.summary: Anchor-alignment pipeline that annotates all known small noncoding RNA species at once, including sncRNA variants, from small RNA-seq reads.

methods.name: AAV-mediated direct in vivo CRISPR screen
methods.title: AAV-mediated direct in vivo CRISPR screen identifies functional suppressors in glioblastoma
methods.summary: AAV delivery of a sgRNA library into conditional-Cas9 mice generates autochthonous glioblastoma-like tumours, and capture sequencing of the tumours reveals which mutations drive them.

methods.name: AAV-SB-CRISPR
methods.title: In vivo CRISPR screening in CD8 T cells with AAV-Sleeping Beauty hybrid vectors identifies membrane targets for improving immunotherapy for glioblastoma
methods.summary: In vivo CRISPR screens using an AAV vector carrying a Sleeping Beauty transposon and sgRNA cassette, so that guide integration gives both editing and a screen readout.

methods.name: Aba-Seq
methods.title: High-resolution enzymatic mapping of genomic 5-hydroxymethylcytosine in mouse embryonic stem cells
methods.summary: The 5hmC-specific restriction enzyme AbaSI cuts at modified sites, and the cut ends are sequenced to map 5hmC at high resolution without chemical conversion.

methods.name: ABAA
methods.title: HCK and ABAA: A Newly Designed Pipeline to Improve Fungi Metabarcoding Analysis
methods.summary: Pipeline step that detects and filters non-specific amplicons in fungal metabarcoding sequencing datasets.

methods.name: ABBA
methods.title: A Bayesian Approach for Analysis of Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing Data Identifies Disease-Associated Changes in DNA Methylation
methods.summary: Bayesian smoothing approach that detects differentially methylated regions from whole-genome bisulfite sequencing, adapting to CpG correlation structure and distance between sites.

methods.name: ABC-seq
methods.title: ABC-seq Expands Small RNAs Profiling with Successive Nucleic Acid Structure-Differentiated Enzymatic Recognition
methods.summary: Small-RNA library prep using two randomized adapters and successive structure-differentiated enzymatic reactions to suppress adapter dimers and add UMIs.

methods.name: ABEILLE
methods.full_name: ABerrant Expression Identification empLoying machine LEarning
methods.title: ABEILLE: a novel method for ABerrant Expression Identification empLoying machine LEarning from RNA-sequencing data
methods.summary: Machine-learning method that identifies aberrant gene expression in rare-disease patients from RNA-seq without arbitrary cut-offs or many replicates.

methods.name: ABEMUS
methods.full_name: Adaptive Base Error Model in Ultra-deep Sequencing data
methods.title: ABEMUS: platform-specific and data-informed detection of somatic SNVs in cfDNA
methods.summary: Platform-specific, data-informed detection of somatic SNVs in cell-free DNA from deep sequencing.

methods.name: AbPair
methods.title: Tumor-infiltrating immune repertoires captured by single-cell barcoding in emulsion
methods.summary: Emulsion-based single-cell barcoding that captures natively paired full-length BCR and TCR sequences, extendable to DNA-labelled antibodies for combined protein and RNA readout.

methods.name: AbsCN-seq
methods.title: AbsCN-seq: a statistical method to estimate tumor purity, ploidy and absolute copy numbers from next-generation sequencing data
methods.summary: Statistical method that estimates tumour purity, ploidy and absolute copy numbers from exome or genome sequencing data.

methods.name: ABSOLUTE
methods.title: Absolute quantification of somatic DNA alterations in human cancer.
methods.summary: Computational method that infers tumour purity and malignant-cell ploidy, and detects subclonal and homozygous somatic alterations.

methods.name: ABSSeq
methods.title: ABSSeq: a new RNA-Seq analysis method based on modelling absolute expression differences
methods.summary: Negative-binomial model of absolute expression differences between conditions for RNA-seq differential expression.

methods.name: ac4C LACE-seq
methods.title: NAT10-mediated mRNA N4-acetylation is essential for the translational regulation during oocyte meiotic maturation in mice
methods.summary: Low-input sequencing method that maps N4-acetylcytidine (ac4C) peaks transcriptome-wide from about 50 mouse oocytes.

methods.name: ac4C-seq
methods.title: Quantitative nucleotide resolution profiling of RNA cytidine acetylation by ac4C-seq
methods.summary: Cyanoborohydride reduction of ac4C induces C-to-T misincorporation during reverse transcription.

methods.name: ACAPseq
methods.full_name: Affinity Capture of Polyribosomes followed by RNA sequencing
methods.title: Affinity capture of polyribosomes followed by RNAseq (ACAPseq), a discovery platform for protein-protein interactions
methods.summary: Polyribosomes are captured on an immobilised protein bait through their nascent polypeptides and the enriched mRNAs are sequenced to find protein-protein interaction partners.

methods.name: ACE
methods.title: ACE: a versatile contrastive learning framework for single-cell mosaic integration
methods.summary: Contrastive-learning framework for mosaic integration of single-cell multi-omics datasets with unequal modality coverage, with alignment (ACE-align) and regression (ACE-spec) strategies.

methods.name: Achim spatial mapping
methods.title: High-throughput spatial mapping of single-cell RNA-seq data to tissue of origin
methods.summary: Assigns single-cell RNA-seq cells to tissue locations by comparing their specificity-weighted mRNA profiles with a positional gene-expression atlas.

methods.name: Acidbio
methods.title: Assessing and assuring interoperability of a genomics file format
methods.summary: Verification system that tests bioinformatics tools for correct handling of genomics file-format edge cases.

methods.name: ACT-seq
methods.targets: histone tail modifications; histone variants; chromatin-binding proteins
methods.title: Antibody-guided Chromatin Tagmentation (ACT-seq)
methods.summary: Antibody-tethered Protein A-Tn5 tagments chromatin at the antigen of interest, mapping histone marks and chromatin-binding proteins genome-wide.

methods.name: ACT2-seq
methods.title: Concurrent mapping of multiple epigenetic marks and co-occupancy using ACT2-seq
methods.summary: Concurrently profiles two or three histone marks or chromatin proteins in one sample and maps their co-occupancy.

methods.name: ActiveDriverWGS
methods.title: Candidate Cancer Driver Mutations in Distal Regulatory Elements and Long-Range Chromatin Interaction Networks
methods.summary: Driver-discovery method that tests cis-regulatory modules across whole tumour genomes for enrichment of SNVs and indels.

methods.name: ADAPT
methods.title: Plasma Exosome Profiling of Cancer Patients by a Next Generation Systems Biology Approach
methods.summary: A library of single-stranded oligonucleotides enriched for binding plasma exosomes is used as an affinity probe set whose recovered sequences give quantitative signatures for patient classification.

methods.name: AECT
methods.title: A Deep-Learning Pipeline for TSS Coverage Imputation From Shallow Cell-Free DNA Sequencing
methods.summary: Deep-learning autoencoder that imputes TSS coverage profiles from shallow cell-free DNA sequencing for cancer screening.

methods.name: AESTETIK
methods.title: Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data.
methods.summary: Convolutional deep learning model that jointly embeds spatial position, spatial transcriptomics and histology morphology to define spatial domains.

methods.name: aFARP-ChIP-seq
methods.title: aFARP-ChIP-seq, a convenient and reliable method for genome profiling in as few as 100 cells with a capability for multiplexing ChIP-seq
methods.summary: Atlantis dsDNase-based ChIP-seq that profiles histone modifications and transcription factor binding from as few as 100 cells with multiplexing.

methods.name: Affinity Distillation
methods.title: De novo  distillation of thermodynamic affinity from deep learning regulatory sequence models of  in vivo  protein-DNA binding
methods.summary: Extracts thermodynamic TF binding affinity models from deep-learning models trained on in vivo binding data.

methods.name: AFS-MetaCache
methods.title: A big data approach to metagenomics for all-food-sequencing
methods.summary: Alignment-free k-mer method (with a Spark version, MetaCacheSpark) for detecting and quantifying species composition in shotgun metagenomic food samples.

methods.name: AFT-OCAP
methods.full_name: alkynyl-functionalized trimethylpiperidine enrichment of O-GlcNAc chromatin-associated proteins
methods.title: A chemical method for genome- and proteome-wide enrichment and O-GlcNAcylation profiling of chromatin-associated proteins
methods.summary: Chemical derivatisation of azide-labelled O-GlcNAc chromatin-associated protein-DNA complexes with an alkynyl AFT reagent for enrichment, then MS and DNA sequencing of their binding sites.

methods.name: AftrRAD
methods.title: AftrRAD: a pipeline for accurate and efficient de novo assembly of RADseq data
methods.summary: Bioinformatic pipeline that assembles and genotypes RADseq data de novo and exports results in formats for downstream analyses.

methods.name: AGNOSTOS
methods.title: AGNOSTOS-DB: a resource to unlock the uncharted regions of the coding sequence space
methods.summary: Database-plus-workflow resource that clusters genes of unknown function across genomes and metagenomes and allows integration of new data.

methods.name: AGOUTI
methods.full_name: Annotated Genome Optimization Using Transcriptome Information
methods.title: AGOUTI: improving genome assembly and annotation using transcriptome data.
methods.summary: Uses RNA-seq data to scaffold contigs and merge fragmented gene models in short-read genome assemblies.

methods.name: Agro-STARR-seq
methods.title: Agro-STARR-seq enables  in planta  genome-wide enhancer discovery and AI-empowerd enhancer design
methods.summary: Agrobacterium-delivered STARR-seq libraries in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves for in planta genome-wide enhancer screening.

methods.name: agtools
methods.title: agtools: a software framework to manipulate assembly graphs
methods.summary: Software framework for manipulating genome assembly graphs.

methods.name: AHT-ChIP-seq
methods.title: AHT-ChIP-seq: a completely automated robotic protocol for high-throughput chromatin immunoprecipitation
methods.summary: Fully automated robotic 96-well ChIP-seq protocol that runs about 400 experiments in five days.

methods.name: AIAP
methods.title: AIAP: A Quality Control and Integrative Analysis Package to Improve ATAC-seq Data Analysis
methods.summary: Package that computes quality control metrics and integrative analysis for ATAC-seq data.

methods.name: aiD-NIPT
methods.full_name: artificial intelligence algorithm using cell-free DNA fragment distance for non-invasive prenatal testing
methods.title: Development and performance evaluation of an artificial intelligence algorithm using cell-free DNA fragment distance for non-invasive prenatal testing (aiD-NIPT)
methods.summary: CNN-based NIPT that detects fetal trisomies 21/18/13 from cfDNA fragment-distance rather than fragment-count features.

methods.name: AIDmut-Seq
methods.full_name: TF-directed activation-induced cytidine deaminase mutagenesis sequencing
methods.title: AIDmut-Seq: a Three-Step Method for Detecting Protein-DNA Binding Specificity
methods.summary: A TF is fused to AID so that C-to-T conversions accumulate near its binding sites, which are then read out by whole-genome sequencing and SNP profiling.

methods.name: AIR-SPACE
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: A temporal and spatial atlas of adaptive immune responses in the lymph node following viral infection
methods.summary: Spatial transcriptomics combined with paired long-read sequencing of T and B cell receptors within the same tissue section.

methods.name: Airpart
methods.title: Airpart: interpretable statistical models for analyzing allelic imbalance in single-cell datasets
methods.summary: Interpretable statistical models for allelic imbalance in single-cell datasets.

methods.name: Akita
methods.title: Predicting 3D genome folding from DNA sequence with Akita.
methods.summary: Convolutional neural network that predicts 3D genome folding (chromatin contact maps) from DNA sequence alone.

methods.name: aKmerBroom
methods.title: aKmerBroom: Ancient oral DNA decontamination using Bloom filters on k-mer sets
methods.summary: Reference-free k-mer decontamination of ancient oral DNA using Bloom filters.

methods.name: ALaP-seq
methods.full_name: APEX-mediated chromatin labeling and purification sequencing
methods.title: Genomic Profiling by ALaP-Seq Reveals Transcriptional Regulation by PML Bodies through DNMT3A Exclusion
methods.summary: APEX-mediated biotin labelling and purification of chromatin next to PML bodies maps which genomic regions sit near the body.

methods.name: ALE-seq
methods.full_name: amplification of LTRs of extrachromosomal linear DNAs
methods.title: Sensitive detection of pre-integration intermediates of long terminal repeat retrotransposons in crop plants
methods.summary: Amplification of LTRs of extrachromosomal linear DNAs detects pre-integration intermediates of LTR retrotransposons to find active elements.

methods.name: ALEA
methods.title: ALEA: a toolbox for allele-specific epigenomics analysis
methods.summary: Toolbox for allele-specific analysis of epigenomic sequencing data that links allelic variants to histone and chromatin signals.

methods.name: alevin-fry
methods.title: Alevin-fry unlocks rapid, accurate and memory-frugal quantification of single-cell RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Framework for quantifying single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq reads into count matrices, faster and more memory-frugal than comparable tools.

methods.name: ALHENA
methods.title: ALHENA, an H&E encoder distilled from transcriptomic foundation models for multi-scale slide analysis
methods.summary: H&E image encoder distilled from transcriptomic foundation models trained on paired H&E and Xenium spatial transcriptomics, requiring only H&E at inference.

methods.name: AlkAniline-Seq
methods.title: AlkAniline-Seq: Profiling of m7 G and m3 C RNA Modifications at Single Nucleotide Resolution
methods.summary: Alkaline heat and aniline cleave RNA at abasic sites of m7G, m3C, D and ho5C, leaving a 5'-phosphate that allows selective adapter ligation for single-nucleotide mapping.

methods.name: Alleleauto
methods.title: Alleleauto: a pipeline for allele identification and analysis of allele-specific gene expression with haplotype-resolved diploid genome assemblies
methods.summary: Workflow that identifies true allelic gene pairs in haplotype-resolved diploid assemblies, filtering paralogs by Ks and synteny, and runs allele-specific expression analysis.

methods.name: ALLSorts
methods.title: ALLSorts: a RNA-Seq classifier for B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
methods.summary: RNA-seq classifier that assigns B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia subtypes from expression data.

methods.name: Alpaca
methods.title: Hybrid assembly with long and short reads improves discovery of gene family expansions
methods.summary: Hybrid assembly pipeline combining long reads with short-insert and long-insert short reads to resolve tandem repeats and gene family expansions.

methods.name: AlphaFamImpute
methods.title: AlphaFamImpute: high-accuracy imputation in full-sib families from genotype-by-sequencing data
methods.summary: Imputation package that calls, phases and imputes genome-wide genotypes in outbred full-sib families from low-coverage genotype-by-sequencing and SNP array data.

methods.name: AlphaFISH
methods.title: Cohort-scale Spatial Host-Microbiome Predicts Post-Resection Recurrence in Colorectal Cancer
methods.summary: Sequencing-free spatial profiling of host and microbial signals in clinical colorectal biopsies, paired with a transformer model for recurrence prediction.

methods.name: AlphaGenome
methods.title: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome.
methods.summary: Unified DNA sequence model that takes 1 Mb of input and predicts thousands of functional genomic tracks across modalities up to single-base-pair resolution.

methods.name: alpine
methods.title: Modeling of RNA-seq fragment sequence bias reduces systematic errors in transcript abundance estimation
methods.summary: Estimates sample-specific bias-corrected transcript abundance by modelling fragment sequence bias.

methods.name: AMAR-seq
methods.full_name: Automated Multimodal Sequencing of DNA Methylation, Chromatin Accessibility, and RNA Expression
methods.title: AMAR-seq: Automated Multimodal Sequencing of DNA Methylation, Chromatin Accessibility, and RNA Expression with Single-Cell Resolution
methods.summary: Automated single-cell co-profiling of DNA methylation, chromatin accessibility and RNA expression from the same cell.

methods.name: AMBER
methods.summary: Automated framework that uses neural architecture search to design CNNs for genomic regulatory-feature prediction from DNA sequence.

methods.name: AmbientMapper
methods.title: Empirical Estimation of Ambient Contamination in Combinatorial Single-Cell Methods Using Multi-Reference Mapping
methods.summary: Generative model that maps reads competitively against multiple references to estimate and remove ambient chromatin signal.

methods.name: Amethyst
methods.title: Single-cell DNA methylation analysis tool Amethyst reveals distinct noncanonical methylation patterns in human glial cells
methods.summary: R package for atlas-scale analysis of single-cell methylation sequencing data, including non-CG methylation patterns.

methods.name: AMOUR
methods.title: Deciphering the RNA landscapes on mammalian cell surfaces
methods.summary: Linear-amplification method that profiles RNAs on the surface of intact live cells.

methods.name: AmPair
methods.title: AmPair: automating housekeeping-gene primer design for species-level metataxonomics
methods.summary: Snakemake pipeline that designs and in silico validates species-level primer pairs for housekeeping-gene amplicon metataxonomics.

methods.name: AmpliCoNE
methods.title: Dosage regulation, and variation in gene expression and copy number of human Y chromosome ampliconic genes
methods.summary: Estimates copy number of Y ampliconic gene families from read sequencing depth.

methods.name: AmpliconSuite
methods.title: AmpliconSuite: an end-to-end workflow for analyzing focal amplifications in cancer genomes
methods.summary: Toolkit that detects and classifies focal amplifications, including extrachromosomal DNA, from cancer whole-genome sequencing.

methods.name: AmpliPiper
methods.title: AmpliPiper: A versatile amplicon-seq analysis tool for multilocus DNA barcoding
methods.summary: Automated pipeline for Oxford Nanopore multilocus amplicon-seq DNA barcoding: demultiplexing, haplotype consensus, species identification, phylogenetics and species delimitation.

methods.name: AmpSeqR
methods.title: AmpSeqR: an R package for amplicon deep sequencing data analysis
methods.summary: R package that filters noise and infers amplicon sequence variants from deep amplicon sequencing data.

methods.name: AMULET
methods.title: AMULET: a novel read count-based method for effective multiplet detection from single nucleus ATAC-seq data
methods.summary: Read-count method that detects multiplets in snATAC-seq by counting regions with more than two uniquely aligned reads.

methods.name: Ancestry_HMM
methods.title: A Hidden Markov Model Approach for Simultaneously Estimating Local Ancestry and Admixture Time Using Next Generation Sequence Data in Samples of Arbitrary Ploidy
methods.summary: Hidden Markov model for joint local ancestry and admixture-time inference from sequencing data of arbitrary ploidy.

methods.name: Ancestry_HMM-S
methods.full_name: Ancestry hidden Markov model for adaptive introgression
methods.title: Inferring Adaptive Introgression Using Hidden Markov Models
methods.summary: Hidden Markov model for identifying genes under adaptive introgression and estimating selection strength from population genomic data.

methods.name: ancIBD
methods.title: Accurate detection of identity-by-descent segments in human ancient DNA
methods.summary: HMM-based detection of identity-by-descent segments in ancient human DNA using imputed genotype probabilities.

methods.name: ANEVA
methods.title: Genetic regulatory variation in populations informs transcriptome analysis in rare disease
methods.summary: Statistical framework that quantifies population-level genetic variation in gene dosage from allelic expression data.

methods.name: ANEVA-DOT
methods.title: Genetic regulatory variation in populations informs transcriptome analysis in rare disease
methods.summary: Outlier test that flags genes in an individual affected by a rare regulatory variant, using ANEVA population variance estimates.

methods.name: AniAnn's
methods.title: AniAnn's: alignment-free annotation of tandem repeat arrays using fast average nucleotide identity estimates
methods.summary: Alignment-free algorithm that annotates tandem repeat arrays from average nucleotide identity between repeat units.

methods.name: ANISE
methods.title: Methods for the detection and assembly of novel sequence in high-throughput sequencing data
methods.summary: Targeted assembler for large novel insertions from paired HTS data, with a repeat-resolution step for near-identical repeats.

methods.name: AnnoAudit
methods.title: AnnoAudit: a marker-based protocol for auditing single-cell atlas annotations, with a self-audit case
methods.summary: Marker-based protocol with four convergent checks and an ambient-aware step that audits single-cell atlas annotations before re-analysis.

methods.name: antibody-barcode eCLIP
methods.full_name: antibody-barcode enhanced UV crosslinking and immunoprecipitation
methods.title: Multiplexed transcriptome discovery of RNA-binding protein binding sites by antibody-barcode eCLIP
methods.summary: Multiplexed eCLIP in which DNA-barcoded antibodies are proximity-ligated to protein-protected RNA fragments, so several RNA-binding proteins are profiled in one library.

methods.name: ANTIPODE
methods.title: ANTIPODE Provides a Global View of Cell Type Homology and Transcriptomic Divergence in the Developing Mammalian Brain
methods.summary: Deep-learning variational inference framework that integrates single-cell datasets, finds homologous cell types and parcellates differential expression across species.

methods.name: Anvi'o
methods.title: Anvi'o: an advanced analysis and visualization platform for 'omics data
methods.summary: Interactive analysis and visualisation platform for characterising microbial genomes in metagenomic assemblies and linking 'omics data.

methods.name: AnVILWorkflow
methods.full_name: Genomic Data Science Analysis, Visualization, and Informatics Lab-space (AnVIL) workflow R package
methods.title: AnVILWorkflow: A runnable workflow package for Cloud-implemented bioinformatics analysis pipelines
methods.summary: R package that submits and retrieves bioinformatics workflows hosted on the AnVIL cloud platform.

methods.name: AP-seq
methods.title: Genomic landscape of oxidative DNA damage and repair reveals regioselective protection from mutagenesis
methods.summary: Biotin-tagging of apurinic (AP) sites with an aldehyde-reactive probe, then streptavidin pull-down of fragmented DNA, maps AP-site damage at about 250 bp resolution genome-wide.

methods.name: Ap2N-RNA-Seq

methods.summary: Web service that tests colocalization of genomic region-sets with several statistical methods in parallel.

methods.name: CoLoRd
methods.title: CoLoRd: compressing long reads
methods.summary: Compression algorithm for third-generation long-read sequencing data that reduces size without changing downstream accuracy.

methods.name: colorSV
methods.title: colorSV: Long-range Somatic Structural Variation Calling from Matched Tumor-normal Co-assembly Graphs
methods.summary: Long-read somatic structural variant caller that calls long-range SVs from joint tumour-normal assembly graphs.

methods.name: comapr
methods.title: sgcocaller and comapr: personalised haplotype assembly and comparative crossover map analysis using single-gamete sequencing data
methods.summary: Companion software to sgcocaller that constructs, visualises and compares individualised crossover landscapes from single-gamete crossover calls.

methods.name: ComBat-ref
methods.title: Highly effective batch effect correction method for RNA-seq count data
methods.summary: Batch-effect correction for RNA-seq counts that picks the lowest-dispersion batch as reference and adjusts other batches toward it using a negative binomial model.

methods.name: Combi-seq
methods.title: Combi-seq for multiplexed transcriptome-based profiling of drug combinations using deterministic barcoding in single-cell droplets
methods.summary: Droplet microfluidics with deterministic combinatorial DNA barcodes reads transcriptome changes for hundreds of drug combinations in single cells.

methods.name: Combinatorial Perturb-seq
methods.title: Exploring genetic interaction manifolds constructed from rich single-cell phenotypes
methods.summary: Perturb-seq with CRISPR activation of single genes and gene pairs, reading single-cell transcriptomes to map genetic interactions.

methods.name: COMET
methods.title: Combinatorial prediction of marker panels from single-cell transcriptomic data
methods.summary: Computational framework that finds combinatorial marker gene panels for cell populations from single-cell RNA-seq data.

methods.name: COMMOT
methods.title: Screening cell–cell communication in spatial transcriptomics via collective optimal transport
methods.summary: Infers spatial cell-cell communication with collective optimal transport, handling competition between ligand and receptor species and spatial distance limits.

methods.name: comparative hMeDIP-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide comparison of DNA hydroxymethylation in mouse embryonic stem cells and neural progenitor cells by a new comparative hMeDIP-seq method
methods.summary: hMeDIP-seq in which differently barcoded input DNA samples are pooled into one immunoprecipitation to compare 5hmC between samples quantitatively.

methods.name: COMPASS
methods.title: Generalizable AI predicts immunotherapy outcomes across cancers and treatments
methods.summary: Pan-cancer transformer that predicts immunotherapy response from bulk tumour transcriptomes via immune concepts.

methods.name: compEpiTools
methods.title: methylPipe and compEpiTools: a suite of R packages for the integrative analysis of epigenomics data
methods.summary: R/Bioconductor companion package that scores, annotates and integrates methylPipe output with other epigenomics data.

methods.name: compleasm
methods.title: compleasm: a faster and more accurate reimplementation of BUSCO
methods.summary: Faster reimplementation of BUSCO that assesses gene completeness of genome assemblies using miniprot alignment.

methods.name: Compressed Perturb-seq
methods.title: Scalable genetic screening for regulatory circuits using compressed Perturb-seq
methods.summary: Perturb-seq variant measuring multiple random perturbations per cell or multiple cells per droplet and computationally decompressing the data.

methods.name: CompTIS
methods.title: Unsupervised Learning Approach for Comparing Multiple Transposon Insertion Sequencing Studies
methods.summary: Unsupervised-learning framework (PCA and clustering) for comparing multiple transposon insertion sequencing screens.

methods.name: Computational array reconstruction
methods.title: Scalable spatial transcriptomics through computational array reconstruction
methods.summary: Imaging-free spatial transcriptomics - the positions of spatial barcodes are reconstructed from molecular diffusion and dimensionality reduction instead of being decoded by imaging, scaling to centimeter-sized tissues.

methods.name: COMRADES
methods.full_name: cross-linking of matched RNAs and deep sequencing
methods.title: COMRADES determines in vivo RNA structures and interactions
methods.summary: Cross-linking of matched RNAs and deep sequencing to capture in vivo RNA conformations and RNA-RNA interactions.

methods.name: ConcatSeq
methods.title: ConcatSeq: A method for increasing throughput of single molecule sequencing by concatenating short DNA fragments
methods.summary: Library preparation that concatenates pools of short DNA fragments into long templates to raise throughput of single-molecule long-read sequencing.

methods.name: CONCERT
methods.title: Generative modeling of spatially resolved perturbation responses with CONCERT
methods.summary: Niche-aware Gaussian-process variational autoencoder that predicts spatially resolved perturbation responses and learns per-perturbation spatial reach.

methods.name: ConDecon
methods.title: Clustering-independent estimation of cell abundances in bulk tissues using single-cell RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Clustering-independent deconvolution that estimates cell abundances along continuous cell states in bulk tissue using scRNA-seq reference.

methods.name: Condense-seq
methods.title: Native nucleosomes intrinsically encode genome organization principles
methods.summary: Native mononucleosomes from MNase-digested chromatin are condensed with physiological polyamines; sequencing the nucleosomes left in solution versus the input gives genome-wide condensability at single-nucleosome resolution.

methods.name: CondenSeq
methods.title: Characterizing protein sequence determinants of nuclear condensates by high-throughput pooled imaging with CondenSeq
methods.summary: Pooled imaging with in situ sequencing that reads protein-sequence library identity inside nuclei while imaging condensate formation, to measure sequence determinants at scale.

methods.name: condiments
methods.title: Trajectory inference across multiple conditions with condiments: differential topology, progression, differentiation, and expression
methods.summary: Method for trajectory inference across multiple conditions in scRNA-seq, comparing topology, progression and expression between groups.

methods.name: ConDoR
methods.title: ConDoR: tumor phylogeny inference with a copy-number constrained mutation loss model
methods.summary: Tumour phylogeny inference from targeted single-cell DNA sequencing using a copy-number constrained SNV loss model.

methods.name: CoNIFER
methods.full_name: copy number inference from exome reads
methods.title: Copy number variation detection and genotyping from exome sequence data
methods.summary: Detects rare genic copy number variants and genotypes copy-number polymorphic loci from exome sequencing data using SVD normalization.

methods.name: Connect-seq
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: Connect-seq to superimpose molecular on anatomical neural circuit maps
methods.summary: Retrograde viral tracing of upstream neurons of a defined circuit combined with single-cell RNA-seq of the sorted infected neurons.

methods.name: Connectome-seq
methods.title: Connectome-seq: high-throughput mapping of neuronal connectivity at single-synapse resolution via barcode sequencing
methods.summary: AAV-delivered engineered synaptic proteins barcode RNA in connected neurons, read out by parallel single-nucleus and single-synaptosome sequencing.

methods.name: ConsHMM
methods.title: Systematic discovery of conservation states for single-nucleotide annotation of the human genome
methods.summary: Multivariate hidden Markov model that learns de novo conservation states from which species align to and match the reference in a multiple-species alignment.

methods.name: ConStrains
methods.title: ConStrains identifies microbial strains in metagenomic datasets.
methods.summary: Identifies conspecific strains from SNP patterns in universal genes in metagenomic data and reconstructs strain phylogenies.

methods.name: contaminationX
methods.title: A likelihood method for estimating present-day human contamination in ancient male samples using low-depth X-chromosome data
methods.summary: Maximum-likelihood estimator of present-day human contamination in low-depth male ancient DNA using the X chromosome.

methods.name: CONTENT
methods.title: Multi-context genetic modeling of transcriptional regulation resolves novel disease loci
methods.summary: Multi-context transcriptome-wide association method with cross-context false-discovery correction that separates shared and context-specific expression.

methods.name: Conterminator
methods.title: Terminating contamination: large-scale search identifies more than 2,000,000 contaminated entries in GenBank
methods.summary: All-against-all sequence comparison tool that detects and removes mislabelled entries in genome reference databases.

methods.name: ContEst
methods.title: ContEst: estimating cross-contamination of human samples in next-generation sequencing data.
methods.summary: Tool that estimates cross-individual sample contamination in next-generation sequencing data, shipped as a GATK module.

methods.name: ContextSV
methods.title: Long-read based detection of large copy number variants with potential functional significance using the ContextSV structural variant caller
methods.summary: Long-read structural-variant caller combining alignment evidence with coverage and SNV allele-frequency copy-number predictions, plus an ML confidence score.

methods.name: Contrastive latent variable model
methods.title: CONTRASTIVE LATENT VARIABLE MODELING WITH APPLICATION TO CASE-CONTROL SEQUENCING EXPERIMENTS
methods.summary: Count-based contrastive latent variable models that separate shared and condition-specific transcriptional variation for differential analysis of sequencing data.

methods.name: Convert-seq
methods.title: Decoding neuronal diversity by single-cell Convert-seq
methods.summary: scRNA-seq combined with pooled ectopic transcription-factor expression, using a strategy that separates exogenous from endogenous transcripts.

methods.name: ConvexML
methods.title: ConvexML: Fast and Accurate Branch Length Estimation under Irreversible Mutation Models, Illustrated through Applications to CRISPR/Cas9-Based Lineage Tracing
methods.summary: Estimates branch lengths for single-cell CRISPR/Cas9 lineage-tracing trees under an irreversible mutation model, giving time-resolved chronograms.

methods.name: COOBoostR
methods.title: COOBoostR: An Extreme Gradient Boosting-Based Tool for Robust Tissue or Cell-of-Origin Prediction of Tumors
methods.summary: Gradient-boosting tool that predicts tissue or cell of origin of tumours from regional somatic mutation density and chromatin marks.

methods.name: Coop-seq
methods.title: Quantitative profiling of selective Sox/POU pairing on hundreds of sequences in parallel by Coop-seq
methods.summary: In vitro assay that measures transcription-factor cooperativity parameters for hundreds of DNA sequence variants in parallel in one experiment.

methods.name: CoPhasing
methods.title: Haplotype-resolved genome architecture mapping uncovers pervasive structural heterogeneity between human homologous chromosomes
methods.summary: Strategy that phases SNV-free GAM reads by proximity to haplotype-informative reads, giving haplotype-resolved 3D genome maps in SNV-sparse human genomes.

methods.name: CoPTR
methods.title: Accurate and robust inference of microbial growth dynamics from metagenomic sequencing reveals personalized growth rates
methods.summary: Computes peak-to-trough ratios from reference genomes and assemblies to estimate microbial growth rates from metagenomes.

methods.name: Copulacci
methods.title: A count-based model for delineating cell-cell interactions in spatial transcriptomics data
methods.summary: Gaussian-copula count model for inferring ligand-receptor cell-cell interactions in spatial transcriptomics.

methods.name: CopyKAT
methods.full_name: copy number karyotyping of aneuploid tumors
methods.title: Delineating copy number and clonal substructure in human tumors from single-cell transcriptomes
methods.summary: Bayesian segmentation for copy-number profiling from scRNA-seq read depth.

methods.name: CopyKit
methods.title: Delineating the copy-number substructure of metastatic tumors with CopyKit
methods.summary: Tool for single-cell DNA copy-number analysis that resolves clonal substructure and reconstructs genetic lineages.

methods.name: CoRe
methods.title: CoRe: a robustly benchmarked R package for identifying core-fitness genes in genome-wide pooled CRISPR-Cas9 screens
methods.summary: R package identifying core-fitness genes from joint analysis of multiple pooled CRISPR-Cas9 screens.

methods.name: CoRMAP
methods.title: Comparative transcriptomics analysis pipeline for the meta-analysis of phylogenetically divergent datasets (CoRMAP)
methods.summary: Meta-analysis pipeline that compares RNA-seq expression across datasets and species using de novo assembly and orthogroup assignment.

methods.name: Corset
methods.title: Corset: enabling differential gene expression analysis for de novo assembled transcriptomes
methods.summary: Hierarchically clusters de novo transcriptome contigs into genes using shared reads and expression, then summarises counts for differential expression.

methods.name: CORT-MDA
methods.full_name: combination of consensus oligonucleotide reverse transcription and multiple displacement amplification
methods.title: Concise and broadly applicable method for determining the genomic sequences of North-American-type porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome viruses in various clusters
methods.summary: Whole-genome shotgun sequencing of North American PRRS viruses after RT with 11 consensus degenerate primers and multiple displacement amplification.

methods.name: CORTAD-seq
methods.full_name: Concurrent RNA and Targeted DNA sequencing
methods.title: Concurrent Single-Cell RNA and Targeted DNA Sequencing on an Automated Platform for Comeasurement of Genomic and Transcriptomic Signatures
methods.summary: Concurrent sequencing of the transcriptome and targeted genomic regions from the same single cell on an automated commercial single-cell isolation platform.

methods.name: Corticall
methods.title: Detection of simple and complex de novo mutations with multiple reference sequences
methods.summary: Graph-based variant caller that combines multisample coloured de Bruijn graphs with long-read haplotypes and reference data to detect de novo mutations.

methods.name: COSICC
methods.title: A single-cell and tissue-scale analysis suite resolves Mixl1's role in heart development
methods.summary: Statistical suite that characterises perturbation effects in complex developing cell populations from single-cell data.

methods.name: COSIE
methods.title: Toward Computationally Complete Spatial Omics
methods.summary: Computational framework that integrates multimodal spatial omics across sections, individuals and platforms into a unified molecular representation and imputes unmeasured modalities.

methods.name: COSIGT
methods.title: Population-scalable genotyping from low-coverage sequencing data using pangenome graphs
methods.summary: Genotyper that infers structural genotypes at complex loci by matching low-coverage short-read patterns to pangenome haplotypes.

methods.name: COSINE
methods.title: COSINE: non-seeding method for mapping long noisy sequences
methods.summary: Non-seeding aligner for long noisy reads that compares k-mer distribution similarity between sequence stretches.

methods.name: CosMx Spatial Molecular Imager
methods.summary: High-plex in situ imaging platform detecting RNA and protein at single-cell and subcellular resolution in FFPE and fresh frozen tissue (NanoString, now Bruker Spatial Biology).

methods.name: CoT
methods.title: CoT: a transformer-based method for inferring tumor clonal copy number substructure from scDNA-seq data
methods.summary: Transformer-autoencoder method that jointly infers tumor clones and their copy number profiles from scDNA-seq data.

methods.name: CoTECH
methods.title: Single-cell joint detection of chromatin occupancy and transcriptome enables higher-dimensional epigenomic reconstructions
methods.summary: Combinatorial barcoding that jointly profiles histone-mark occupancy and transcriptome in the same single cells.

methods.name: Cotranscriptional SHAPE-seq
methods.full_name: selective 2'-hydroxyl acylation analyzed by primer-extension sequencing (SHAPE-seq), applied cotranscriptionally
methods.title: Cotranscriptional folding of a riboswitch at nucleotide resolution
methods.summary: SHAPE-seq extended to nascent RNA during transcription, giving nucleotide-resolution cotranscriptional folding maps.

methods.name: Count splitting
methods.title: Inference after latent variable estimation for single-cell RNA sequencing data
methods.summary: Framework that splits Poisson counts so that gene-level tests after latent variable estimation (e.g. cell type or pseudotime) in scRNA-seq keep valid Type 1 error control.

methods.name: CountESS
methods.title: CountESS: a flexible, graphical pipeline tool for deep mutational scanning analysis
methods.summary: Flexible graphical pipeline tool for processing deep mutational scanning sequencing data into variant scores.

methods.name: countsimQC
methods.title: Towards unified quality verification of synthetic count data with countsimQC
methods.summary: Generates a stand-alone quality report comparing synthetic count data with the experimental data they mimic.

methods.name: COURIER
methods.full_name: Controlled output and uptake of RNA for interrogation, expression and regulation
methods.aliases: engineered RNA export (Horns 2023); controlled output and uptake of RNA for interrogation, expression, and regulation
methods.title: Engineering RNA export for measurement and manipulation of living cells
methods.summary: Genetically encoded viral-inspired RNA exporters package barcoded RNA into nanoparticles that cells secrete, allowing non-destructive sampling of living cell populations over time.

methods.name: COVIDomic
methods.title: COVIDomic: A multi-modal cloud-based platform for identification of risk factors associated with COVID-19 severity
methods.summary: Cloud multi-omics platform that analyses COVID-19 patient metatranscriptomic data to infer SARS-CoV-2 strain origin and predict severity risk factors.

methods.name: CP-AL
methods.title: Development of coupling controlled polymerizations by adapter-ligation in mate-pair sequencing for detection of various genomic variants in one single assay
methods.summary: Gel-free, biotin-capture-free mate-pair method that couples controlled polymerizations with adapter-ligation to detect genomic variants.

methods.name: CP-CSeq
methods.title: Characterization of genome-wide ordered sequence-tagged Mycobacterium mutant libraries by Cartesian Pooling-Coordinate Sequencing
methods.summary: Pools sequence-tagged mutants arrayed in well plates in Cartesian coordinates, so sequencing reports both each clone's identity and its plate location; applied to a BCG transposon mutant library.

methods.name: cP-RNA-seq
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: Sex hormone-dependent tRNA halves enhance cell proliferation in breast and prostate cancers
methods.summary: Periodate treatment after phosphatase removes the 3' ends of all small RNAs except those with a 2',3'-cyclic phosphate, so only tRNA halves and other cP-RNAs are ligated, amplified and sequenced.

methods.name: CPA
methods.title: Predicting cellular responses to complex perturbations in high-throughput screens
methods.summary: Compositional autoencoder predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to unseen perturbation combinations.

methods.name: CPA-Perturb-seq
methods.full_name: Perturb-seq of cleavage and polyadenylation (CPA) regulators
methods.title: Multiplexed single-cell characterization of alternative polyadenylation regulators
methods.summary: Multiplexed Perturb-seq screen of 42 cleavage and polyadenylation regulators with a 3' scRNA-seq readout for transcriptome-wide polyA site usage.

methods.name: CPA-seq
methods.full_name: Cap-Clip acid pyrophosphatase, T4 polynucleotide kinase and AlkB/AlkB(D135S)-facilitated small ncRNA sequencing
methods.title: CPA-seq reveals small ncRNAs with methylated nucleosides and diverse termini
methods.summary: Small ncRNA sequencing with Cap-Clip, PNK and AlkB treatments to capture RNAs with diverse termini and methylated nucleosides.

methods.name: CPAT
methods.title: CPAT: Coding-Potential Assessment Tool using an alignment-free logistic regression model
methods.summary: Alignment-free logistic regression tool that separates coding from noncoding transcripts using ORF size, ORF coverage, Fickett score and hexamer bias.

methods.name: CpGFuse
methods.title: CpGFuse: a holistic approach for accurate identification of methylation states of DNA CpG sites
methods.summary: Fused-feature model that imputes CpG methylation states in single cells from other cells of the same type.

methods.name: Cpipe
methods.title: Cpipe: a shared variant detection pipeline designed for diagnostic settings.
methods.summary: Shared variant-detection pipeline designed for clinical diagnostic sequencing.

methods.name: CPM
methods.title: Cell composition analysis of bulk genomics using single-cell data
methods.summary: Deconvolution algorithm that uses reference scRNA-seq profiles to infer cell composition of bulk samples.

methods.name: CPT-seq
methods.title: In vitro, long-range sequence information for de novo genome assembly via transposase contiguity
methods.summary: In vitro transposase-based long-range library in sparse indexed pools that supplies contiguity information for genome scaffolding.

methods.name: CrAAVe-seq
methods.title: CRISPR screening by AAV episome-sequencing (CrAAVe-seq): a scalable cell-type-specific in vivo platform uncovers neuronal essential genes.
methods.summary: AAV-delivered pooled CRISPR knockout screen with a Cre-sensitive sgRNA cassette, so guides are expressed only in chosen cell populations within mouse tissue.

methods.name: CRACI
methods.full_name: Chemical Reduction Assisted Cytosine Incorporation sequencing
methods.title: Quantitative CRACI reveals transcriptome-wide distribution of RNA dihydrouridine at base resolution
methods.summary: Chemically reduces dihydrouridine so that reverse transcription misincorporates cytosine, giving base-resolution quantitative maps of D.

methods.name: CRAGE-RB-PI-seq
methods.full_name: chassis-independent recombinase assisted genome engineering with randomly-barcoded promoter-library insertion sequencing
methods.title: CRAGE-RB-PI-seq enables transcriptional profiling of rhizobacteria during plant-root colonization
methods.summary: Barcoded promoter-library insertion into bacteria, with targeted amplification of barcoded transcripts to measure promoter activities during plant-root colonization.

methods.name: CRE-AI-TIVE
methods.title: A scalable method for modulating plant gene expression using a multispecies genomic model and protoplast-based massively parallel reporter assay
methods.summary: Platform combining a multispecies plant sequence-to-expression model, in silico promoter mutagenesis and protoplast MPRA validation to tune plant gene expression.

methods.name: CREMA
methods.title: Peak-agnostic high-resolution cis-regulatory circuitry mapping using single cell multiome data.
methods.summary: Models gene expression and chromatin activity per cell in multiome data to recover cis-regulatory circuits without peak calling.

methods.name: CREME
methods.title: Interpreting cis-regulatory interactions from large-scale deep neural networks
methods.summary: In silico perturbation toolkit that interprets a genomic deep neural network (Enformer) to find cis-regulatory elements that enhance or silence gene expression.

methods.name: CREP
methods.title: CREP: Cis-Regulatory Element Predictor Based on Fine-Tuned Enformer
methods.summary: Fine-tuned Enformer model that predicts discrete cis-regulatory element annotations from DNA sequence.

methods.name: CRES-Seq
methods.title: CRISPR-Cas9-Edited Site Sequencing (CRES-Seq): An Efficient and High-Throughput Method for the Selection of CRISPR-Cas9-Edited Clones
methods.summary: Multiplexed amplicon sequencing that genotypes up to 96 CRISPR-Cas9 edited sites per MiniSeq run to select edited clones.

methods.name: CREST-seq
methods.full_name: cis-regulatory element scan by tiling-deletion and sequencing
methods.title: A tiling-deletion-based genetic screen for cis-regulatory element identification in mammalian cells
methods.summary: Tiles deletions across a locus and reads out their pooled effects to map functional cis-regulatory elements.

methods.name: CREsted
methods.full_name: cis-regulatory element sequence training, explanation and design
methods.title: CREsted: modeling genomic and synthetic cell-type-specific enhancers across tissues and species
methods.summary: Software package for preprocessing, modelling, designing and analysing cell-type-specific enhancers from scATAC-seq data.

methods.name: CReVIS-seq
methods.title: CReVIS-Seq: A highly accurate and multiplexable method for genome-wide mapping of lentiviral integration sites
methods.summary: Fragmented genomic DNA is circularised in vitro and cut at the viral sequence by Cas9/sgRNA so integration sites are sequenced without PCR enrichment bias.

methods.name: CRIP
methods.title: CRIP: predicting circRNA-RBP-binding sites using a codon-based encoding and hybrid deep neural networks.
methods.summary: Hybrid CNN-RNN model with codon-based encoding that predicts RBP binding sites on circRNAs from RNA sequence alone.

methods.name: CRISP-seq
methods.title: Dissecting Immune Circuits by Linking CRISPR-Pooled Screens with Single-Cell RNA-Seq
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPR screens linked to single-cell RNA-seq so that each cell's perturbation and transcriptome are measured together.

methods.name: CRISPore-seq
methods.title: Transcriptome-wide profiling of alternative splicing regulators with CRISPore-seq
methods.summary: Pooled single-cell CRISPR perturbation screen with joint short- and long-read transcriptomics that resolves perturbation-driven splicing at isoform level.

methods.name: CRISPR-CATCH
methods.full_name: CRISPR-Cas9 Assisted Targeting of CHromosome segments
methods.title: Targeted profiling of human extrachromosomal DNA by CRISPR-CATCH
methods.summary: Targeted purification of megabase-sized ecDNA by in vitro Cas9 cutting of agarose-entrapped DNA and pulsed-field gel electrophoresis, followed by sequencing.

methods.name: CRISPR-DS
methods.full_name: CRISPR/Cas9 targeted genome fragmentation with Duplex Sequencing
methods.title: Targeted genome fragmentation with CRISPR/Cas9 enables fast and efficient enrichment of small genomic regions and ultra-accurate sequencing with low DNA input (CRISPR-DS)
methods.summary: Cas9 cleavage produces uniform-length fragments of target regions for size-selected enrichment and Duplex Sequencing.

methods.name: CRISPR-GEMM
methods.title: CRISPR-GEMM Pooled Mutagenic Screening Identifies KMT2D as a Major Modulator of Immune Checkpoint Blockade
methods.summary: Pooled mutagenic CRISPR screens in genetically engineered mouse models, read out by sequencing to find tumor genes that modulate immune checkpoint blockade response.

methods.name: CRISPR-KOALA
methods.full_name: CRISPR-Knock Out and Activation Linked Assay
methods.title: Aneuploidy drives the acquisition of cancer-specific driver genes
methods.summary: Bidirectional (knockout plus activation) pooled CRISPR screening in immune-competent mouse cancer models, used on all genes of frequently altered chromosome arms.

methods.name: CRISPR-NGS
methods.full_name: CRISPR-Cas9-modified next-generation sequencing for antibiotic resistance gene enrichment
methods.title: Enhanced detection for antibiotic resistance genes in wastewater samples using a CRISPR-enriched metagenomic method
methods.summary: Cas9-based enrichment during library preparation raises the detection of low-abundance antibiotic resistance genes in wastewater metagenomes.

methods.name: CRISPR-PAMdb
methods.title: Uncovering Cas9 PAM diversity through metagenomic mining and machine learning
methods.summary: Database of Cas9 proteins and their inferred PAM preferences, compiled from bacterial, archaeal, phage and plasmid sequences.

methods.name: CRISPR-sciATAC
methods.title: Profiling the genetic determinants of chromatin accessibility with scalable single-cell CRISPR screens
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPR perturbations read out by combinatorial-indexing scATAC-seq, linking each guide to chromatin accessibility in the same cell.

methods.name: CRISPR-suppressor scanning
methods.title: Target identification of small molecules using large-scale CRISPR-Cas mutagenesis scanning of essential genes
methods.summary: Cas9 sgRNAs tiled across essential genes generate in-frame mutants whose enrichment under drug treatment identifies drug targets and resistance mutations.

methods.name: CRISPR-Tag-seq
methods.title: Tag-seq: a convenient and scalable method for genome-wide specificity assessment of CRISPR/Cas nucleases
methods.summary: A double-stranded oligo Tag integrates into Cas-nuclease-induced double-strand breaks and is traced by one-step library prep to profile off-target sites.

methods.name: CRISPR-X
methods.title: Directed evolution using dCas9-targeted somatic hypermutation in mammalian cells
methods.summary: dCas9 with MS2-recruited AID variants generates local mutagenesis around sgRNA targets in endogenous loci, followed by selection and sequencing of enriched variants.

methods.name: CRISPRgenee
methods.title: CRISPR GENome and epigenome engineering improves loss-of-function genetic-screening approaches
methods.summary: Paired sgRNAs that simultaneously cleave and repress a target gene, improving loss-of-function screen efficiency and consistency over CRISPRko and CRISPRi.

methods.name: CRISPRi genetic interaction mapping
methods.title: Genetic interaction mapping in mammalian cells using CRISPR interference
methods.summary: Pooled double-sgRNA CRISPRi screens targeting pairs of chromatin regulators, scoring genetic interactions from relative enrichment of sgRNA pairs.

methods.name: CRISPRi Perturb-seq
methods.title: A Multiplexed Single-Cell CRISPR Screening Platform Enables Systematic Dissection of the Unfolded Protein Response
methods.summary: Perturb-seq with dCas9-KRAB gene repression instead of knockout, used to map genetic interactions in the unfolded protein response from single-cell transcriptomes.

methods.name: CRISPRi tiling screen
methods.title: Systematic mapping of functional enhancer–promoter connections with CRISPR interference
methods.summary: CRISPRi guides tiled across ~1.3 Mb of noncoding sequence around MYC and GATA1, with guide representation counted by sequencing after cell growth to find the enhancers that control those genes.

methods.name: CRISPRi-seq
methods.title: Exploration of Bacterial Bottlenecks and Streptococcus pneumoniae Pathogenesis by CRISPRi-Seq
methods.summary: Inducible CRISPR interference system for genome-wide fitness testing of Streptococcus pneumoniae in one sequencing step, applied in a mouse pneumonia model.

methods.name: CRISPRi/a pooled screening
methods.title: Genome-Scale CRISPR-Mediated Control of Gene Repression and Activation
methods.summary: Pooled genome-scale screens using dCas9 fused to a repressor or activator, with guide abundance counted by sequencing to score gene repression or activation phenotypes.

methods.name: CRISPRiSeq
methods.title: Improved discovery of genetic interactions using CRISPRiSeq across multiple environments
methods.summary: Pooled-growth CRISPRi sequencing assay that measures pairwise genetic interactions in yeast across multiple growth conditions from barcode fitness readouts.

methods.name: CRISPRmap
methods.title: Mapping multimodal phenotypes to perturbations in cells and tissue with CRISPRmap
methods.summary: Optical pooled CRISPR screen that reads guide barcodes in situ by combinatorial hybridization, with multiplexed immunofluorescence.

methods.name: CRISPRpath
methods.title: Parallel characterization of cis-regulatory elements for multiple genes using CRISPRpath.
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPRi and CRISPRn screen that characterises cis-regulatory elements of several genes in one pathway in parallel.

methods.name: CRISPRpic
methods.full_name: CRISPR-induced mutation analysis via prefixed index counting
methods.title: CRISPRpic: fast and precise analysis for CRISPR-induced mutations via prefixed index counting
methods.summary: Fast exact-match algorithm calling CRISPR-induced mutations from amplicon sequencing reads.

methods.name: crisprQTL mapping
methods.title: crisprQTL mapping as a genome-wide association framework for cellular genetic screens
methods.summary: Single-cell CRISPRi screen in which each cell receives many random gRNAs and enhancer-gene links are tested like eQTLs from scRNA-seq.

methods.name: CRISPuRe-seq
methods.title: CRISPuRe-seq: pooled screening of barcoded ribonucleoprotein reporters reveals regulation of RNA polymerase III transcription by the integrated stress response via mTOR
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPR screen in which genotype is linked to phenotype by purifying ribonucleoprotein complexes that carry expressed RNA barcodes.

methods.name: CRITR-seq
methods.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
methods.title: CRISPR with Transcriptional Readout reveals influenza transcription is modulated by NELF and can precipitate an interferon response
methods.summary: CRISPR screen in which each guide sequence is linked to activity at a promoter of interest, read out by sequencing.

methods.name: CRNET
methods.title: CRNET: an efficient sampling approach to infer functional regulatory networks by integrating large-scale ChIP-seq and time-course RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Bayesian two-stage Gibbs sampler inferring functional regulatory networks from ChIP-seq and time-course RNA-seq data.

methods.name: CROP-seq
methods.title: Pooled CRISPR screening with single-cell transcriptome readout
methods.summary: Pooled CRISPR screens read out by single-cell RNA-seq, with the guide RNA captured as a polyadenylated transcript.

methods.name: CrosscheckFingerprints
methods.title: Detecting sample swaps in diverse NGS data types using linkage disequilibrium
methods.summary: Tool using linkage disequilibrium fingerprints to quantify sample relatedness and detect swapped or mislabelled sequencing datasets.

methods.name: CrossHub
methods.title: CrossHub: a tool for multi-way analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) in the context of gene expression regulation mechanisms
methods.summary: Software for multi-way analysis of TCGA data that links TF-gene co-expression, miRNA-mRNA pairs and promoter methylation to gene expression regulation.

methods.name: CROWN-seq
methods.title: Decoding m6Am by simultaneous transcription-start mapping and methylation quantification
methods.summary: Sequencing method that maps adenosine transcription-start nucleotides and quantifies m6Am stoichiometry for each 5' isoform.

methods.name: CRSP
methods.title: A Nile rat transcriptomic landscape across 22 organs by ultra-deep sequencing and comparative RNA-seq pipeline (CRSP)

methods.name: DRUG-seq-PerturbFormer

methods.summary: Multi-task deep-learning framework that predicts metabolite perturbation magnitude and direction in T cell transcriptomes.

methods.name: drug2cell

methods.summary: Druggable target prediction tool that combines single-cell profiles with drug-target interactions to score drug effects per cell type.

methods.name: DrugTargetSeqR

methods.summary: Identifies physiological drug targets by sequencing drug-resistant human cell clones, computationally finding mutations and confirming them with CRISPR-Cas9 editing.

methods.name: DRUT
methods.full_name: Discovery and Reconstruction of Unannotated Transcripts

methods.name: DSBCapture

methods.name: DSBS

methods.summary: Hairpin adapter locks Watson and Crick strands together before bisulfite treatment so one paired-end read gives SNVs and methylation together.

methods.name: dscATAC-seq

methods.name: dscHi-C
methods.title: Droplet-based high-throughput 3D genome structure mapping of single cells with simultaneous transcriptomics

methods.name: dsciATAC-seq

methods.name: dscNanoATAC
methods.title: A droplet-based long-read single-cell epigenome sequencing method for the high-throughput profiling of multidimensional regulatory elements within individual cells
methods.summary: Droplet-based single-cell long-read (Nanopore) ATAC-seq profiling chromatin accessibility in thousands of cells.

methods.name: dscNanoCUT
methods.title: A droplet-based long-read single-cell epigenome sequencing method for the high-throughput profiling of multidimensional regulatory elements within individual cells
methods.summary: Droplet-based single-cell long-read (Nanopore) CUT&Tag profiling histone modifications in thousands of cells.

methods.name: dSort-Seq
methods.title: Deep-learning-assisted Sort-Seq enables high-throughput profiling of gene expression characteristics with high precision
methods.summary: Deep-learning-assisted Sort-Seq: FACS binning plus sequencing and image-based learning to profile expression strength and noise of library variants.

methods.name: dsRNA-Seq
methods.title: dsRNA-Seq: Identification of Viral Infection by Purifying and Sequencing dsRNA
methods.summary: Double-stranded RNA purified from total RNA and sequenced to identify RNA viruses from the dsRNA they make while replicating.

methods.name: DSS
methods.title: Differential methylation analysis for BS-seq data under general experimental design
methods.summary: Bioconductor package for differential methylation analysis of bisulfite sequencing data under general experimental designs, using beta-binomial regression with arcsine link.

methods.name: DSSC
methods.title: A model-based constrained deep learning clustering approach for spatially resolved single-cell data
methods.summary: Deep clustering of spatially resolved scRNA-seq data that uses spatial coordinates and marker-gene constraints to guide an autoencoder.

methods.name: dTn-Seq
methods.title: Droplet Tn-Seq combines microfluidics with Tn-Seq for identifying complex single-cell phenotypes
methods.summary: Transposon-insertion (Tn-Seq) fitness screen in which individual mutants are encapsulated in microfluidic droplets so each grows in isolation.

methods.name: dTNT-seq
methods.title: An Integrated Dielectrophoresis-Trapping and Nanowell Transfer Approach to Enable Double-Sub-Poisson Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
methods.summary: Dielectrophoresis trapping plus nanowell transfer that loads cells and beads in a sub-Poisson manner for scRNA-seq.

methods.name: DTPSP
methods.title: DTPSP: A Deep Learning Framework for Optimized Time Point Selection in Time-Series Single-Cell Studies
methods.summary: Deep-learning framework that selects the most informative time points for time-series bulk or single-cell studies and imputes data for unsampled time points.

methods.name: DualRP
methods.title: Dual Ribosome Profiling reveals metabolic limitations of cancer and stromal cells in the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Ribosome profiling that reads translation and codon-resolved ribosome stalling simultaneously in multiple tumour cell populations.

methods.name: DUET-seq
methods.title: DUET-seq: An Open-Source Droplet Platform for High-Fidelity Joint Chromatin and Transcriptome Profiling Reveals Temporal Regulatory Decoupling in Single Cells
methods.summary: Open-source droplet platform that co-profiles chromatin accessibility and RNA from the same nucleus, using dissolvable dual-linker hydrogel beads and one-step intra-droplet RT-PCR.

methods.name: duphold

methods.summary: Annotates structural variant calls with depth-of-coverage information to add or remove confidence in copy-number-changing events.

methods.name: Duplex Proximity Sequencing
methods.title: Duplex Proximity Sequencing (Pro-Seq): A method to improve DNA sequencing accuracy without the cost of molecular barcoding redundancy
methods.summary: Library construction that physically links multiple copies of each cfDNA template so they seed one sequencing cluster, lowering error without redundant barcoded reads.

methods.name: Duplex Sequencing

methods.title: Detection of ultra-rare mutations by next-generation sequencing

methods.name: DUSC
methods.title: A hybrid deep clustering approach for robust cell type profiling using single-cell RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Hybrid deep clustering approach for robust cell type profiling from noisy scRNA-seq data.

methods.name: DVG-profiler

methods.name: Dyna-vivo-seq

methods.summary: In vivo metabolic RNA labeling combined with scRNA-seq to profile new versus old RNA at single-cell level.

methods.name: DynaVelo

methods.summary: Generative neural ODE model that learns joint gene-expression and TF-motif-activity dynamics from single-cell multiome data and supports in silico perturbation.

methods.name: DZ-seq

methods.summary: A-tailing plus oligo-dT reverse transcription reads cleavage status and sequence of thousands of RNA-cleaving deoxyribozymes and their RNA substrates in one run.

methods.name: E/L Repli-seq

methods.name: e2MPRA

methods.name: EASTR

methods.name: Easy Dip-C

methods.name: EasyDIVER

methods.name: EasyMetagenome
methods.title: EasyMetagenome: A user-friendly and flexible pipeline for shotgun metagenomic analysis in microbiome research
methods.summary: User-friendly pipeline for shotgun metagenomic analysis covering QC, read- and assembly-based analysis and binning.

methods.name: easyRNASeq

methods.summary: Emulsion PCR that links functional genes to phylogenetic marker genes in single cells, read out by sequencing.

methods.title: ERDS-exome: a Hybrid Approach for Copy Number Variant Detection from Whole-exome Sequencing Data

methods.summary: Neural discrete representation model that removes batch effects and estimates perturbation- or condition-associated signals at single-cell resolution.

methods.name: NEAT-seq

methods.name: needLR

methods.name: NET-seq

methods.name: NetDes-Duo

methods.name: NetSig
methods.title: NetSig: network-based discovery from cancer genomes
methods.summary: Statistic that combines protein interaction networks with tumour exome data to identify candidate cancer driver genes.

methods.name: NEWPAT

methods.summary: Noninvasive prenatal paternity test that uses an amplicon panel of double nucleotide polymorphisms in fetal cell-free DNA to reduce sequencing-error false calls.

methods.name: NEXSON

methods.summary: Ultrasound-based nuclei extraction (Nuclei EXtraction by SONication) that standardises ChIP-seq across cell types and down to about 10,000 cells.

methods.name: nextPARS
methods.title: nextPARS: parallel probing of RNA structures in Illumina
methods.summary: Illumina-based in vitro parallel probing of RNA structures with higher throughput and sample multiplexing.

methods.name: NexuST
methods.title: NexuST: A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics

methods.name: nf-core/pangenome

methods.summary: Nextflow pipeline for reproducible, parallelised biobank-scale genome-wide association studies.

methods.name: NGLess
methods.title: NG-meta-profiler: fast processing of metagenomes using NGLess, a domain-specific language
methods.summary: Domain-specific language for reproducible next-generation sequence processing pipelines.

methods.name: NGSANE

methods.name: NicheCorr

methods.name: NOMe-seq

methods.summary: Computational framework for bulk (RE-seq) and single-cell (scRE-seq) quantification, differential analysis and annotation of RNA editing.
