methods.summary: Trajectory inference of pathway significance: scores which pathways and genes drive a scRNA-seq trajectory and when they change along pseudotime.

methods.name: TIS-Seq
methods.title: Transposon Insertion Site Sequencing (TIS-Seq): An Efficient and High-Throughput Method for Determining Transposon Insertion Site(s) and Their Relative Abundances in a PiggyBac Transposon Mutant Pool by Next-Generation Sequencing
methods.summary: Sequencing method that identifies PiggyBac transposon insertion sites and relative mutant abundances in a mutant pool.

methods.name: TISCalling
methods.title: TISCalling: leveraging machine learning to identify translational initiation sites in plants and viruses
methods.summary: Machine-learning and statistical framework that identifies and ranks translation initiation sites across eukaryotes from mRNA sequence features.

methods.name: TISCC-seq
methods.title: Direct measurement of engineered cancer mutations and their transcriptional phenotypes in single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell workflow that engineers TP53 mutations with CRISPR base editors and reads each cell's edited transcript by long-read sequencing alongside short-read transcriptomes.

methods.name: TissueFormer
methods.title: Multi-Modal Foundation Model with Whole-Slide Attention Enables Transferrable Digital Pathology at Single-Cell Resolution
methods.summary: Foundation model with linear-complexity whole-slide attention, pretrained on paired histopathology and spatial transcriptomics at single-cell resolution.

methods.name: TissueTypist
methods.title: Dynamics of human cardiogenesis and its disruption in trisomy 21
methods.summary: Context-aware, resolution-agnostic niche classification tool for single-cell and spatial multiomics data.

methods.name: Tite-Seq
methods.title: Measuring the sequence-affinity landscape of antibodies with massively parallel titration curves
methods.summary: Measures antigen-binding titration curves and affinities for thousands of antibody variants in parallel, read out by sequencing.

methods.name: TIVA
methods.title: Transcriptome in vivo analysis (TIVA) of spatially defined single cells in live tissue
methods.summary: Photoactivatable tag captures mRNA from individual cells in live tissue for RNA-seq, preserving their microenvironment.

methods.name: TL-seq
methods.title: Roles for transcript leaders in translation and mRNA decay revealed by transcript leader sequencing
methods.summary: Enzymatic capture of m7G-capped mRNA 5' ends maps transcript leaders genome-wide; a polysome-fractionation variant (TATL-seq) assays their translation.

methods.name: TM3'seq
methods.title: TM3'seq: A Tagmentation-Mediated 3' Sequencing Approach for Improving Scalability of RNAseq Experiments
methods.summary: Low-cost 3'-enriched RNA-seq library method that uses Tn5 tagmentation and keeps each sample's identity through processing.

methods.name: tMCTA-seq
methods.full_name: targeted methylated CpG tandem amplification and sequencing
methods.title: A targeted DNA methylation method for detecting gastrointestinal cancer in circulating cell-free DNA
methods.summary: Targeted methylated CpG tandem amplification of 110 cfDNA methylation sites after bisulfite conversion, for cancer detection from plasma.

methods.name: TMUR-seq
methods.title: Barcoded Sleeping Beauty Transposons as Mobile Reporters of Chromatin Architecture
methods.summary: Uniquely barcoded Sleeping Beauty transposon junction-recovery sequencing that links secondary transposition events to their donor sites.

methods.name: Tn-Core
methods.title: Tn-Core: A Toolbox for Integrating Tn-seq Gene Essentiality Data and Constraint-Based Metabolic Modeling
methods.summary: Toolbox that integrates Tn-seq gene essentiality data with constraint-based metabolic models to interpret Tn-seq datasets and find data gaps.

methods.name: Tn-seq
methods.title: Tn-seq: high-throughput parallel sequencing for fitness and genetic interaction studies in microorganisms
methods.summary: Saturated Mariner transposon insertion library is selected and insertion-flanking regions are sequenced en masse to measure each mutant's fitness and genetic interactions genome-wide.

methods.name: Tn5Prime
methods.title: Tn5Prime, a Tn5 based 5' capture method for single cell RNA-seq
methods.summary: Tn5-based Smart-seq2 variant that captures the 5' ends of transcripts and adds cell identifiers during reverse transcription.

methods.name: tncRNA Toolkit
methods.title: tncRNA Toolkit: A pipeline for convenient identification of RNA (tRNA)-derived non-coding RNAs
methods.summary: Pipeline that identifies tRNA-derived non-coding RNA classes (tRF-5, tRF-3, tRF-1, tRH) from small RNA-seq data.

methods.name: TNSEEK
methods.title: Comparative essentialome analysis of six Pectobacteriaceae strains using the TNSEEK pipeline identifies conserved and strain-specific fitness determinants
methods.summary: Fully automated pipeline for comparative Tn-seq analysis that calls core and strain-specific essential genes across multiple strains.

methods.name: Toblerone
methods.title: Toblerone: detecting exon deletion events in cancer using RNA-seq
methods.summary: Pseudoalignment-based detection of exon deletions from RNA-seq, using a transcriptome reference of deletion isoforms; applied to IKZF1 in B-ALL.

methods.name: TOD-Bayes
methods.full_name: naive Bayes algorithm for tissue origin diagnosis
methods.title: A naive Bayes algorithm for tissue origin diagnosis (TOD-Bayes) of synchronous multifocal tumors in the hepatobiliary and pancreatic system
methods.summary: Naive Bayes classifier of tissue origin of synchronous multifocal tumors from RNA-seq expression of about 1000 feature genes.

methods.name: TOD-CUP
methods.full_name: tissue origin diagnosis of cancers of unknown primary
methods.title: TOD-CUP: a gene expression rank-based majority vote algorithm for tissue origin diagnosis of cancers of unknown primary
methods.summary: Gene-expression rank-based majority-vote classifier predicting tissue of origin for cancers of unknown primary.

methods.name: TOFU-MAaPO
methods.full_name: Taxonomic Or FUnctional Metagenomic Assembly and PrOfiling
methods.title: TOFU-MAaPO: fast, scalable and reproducible analysis of large metagenome sequence data from the Sequence Read Archive
methods.summary: Nextflow pipeline for large-scale metagenome analysis from local or SRA short reads, covering assembly, binning of MAGs, and assembly-free taxonomic profiling.

methods.name: Tomo-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide RNA Tomography in the zebrafish embryo
methods.summary: Cryosections of an embryo or tissue are sequenced individually by RNA-seq to give genome-wide expression along spatial axes.

methods.name: ToNER
methods.title: ToNER: A tool for identifying nucleotide enrichment signals in feature-enriched RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Statistical tool that models enrichment between enriched and unenriched RNA-seq libraries to call RNA 5' end sites (Cappable-seq, dRNA-seq).

methods.name: TooManyCells
methods.title: TooManyCells identifies and visualizes relationships of single-cell clades
methods.summary: Graph-based divisive spectral clustering and a graph visualization that show single-cell clades at multiple resolutions instead of one fixed clustering resolution.

methods.name: TOP-LD
methods.title: TOP-LD: A tool to explore linkage disequilibrium with TOPMed whole-genome sequence data
methods.summary: Tool to explore linkage disequilibrium using TOPMed whole-genome sequence data.

methods.name: TOP-seq
methods.title: Tethered Oligonucleotide-Primed Sequencing, TOP-Seq: A High-Resolution Economical Approach for DNA Epigenome Profiling
methods.summary: Covalent tagging of unmodified CG sites followed by non-homologous polymerase priming at the tag directly yields adjoining regions for single-CG-resolution DNA methylation mapping.

methods.name: TopHat
methods.title: TopHat: discovering splice junctions with RNA-Seq
methods.summary: Spliced aligner that maps RNA-seq reads and discovers splice junctions using Bowtie.

methods.name: TopHat2
methods.title: TopHat2: accurate alignment of transcriptomes in the presence of insertions, deletions and gene fusions
methods.summary: Spliced RNA-seq aligner that handles variable-length indels, fusion breaks and known-transcript mapping.

methods.name: TOPmentation
methods.title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
methods.summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

methods.name: TopoMetry
methods.title: TopoMetry systematically learns and evaluates the latent geometry of single-cell data
methods.summary: Geometry-aware framework that learns spectral scaffolds of single-cell data to preserve its latent geometry for clustering and visualisation.

methods.name: Torino
methods.title: Reference-free isoform discovery links unannotated RNA processing to disease risk

methods.name: TORMES
methods.title: TORMES: an automated pipeline for whole bacterial genome analysis
methods.summary: Automated pipeline for whole bacterial genome analysis from Illumina reads: QC, assembly, annotation, MLST, resistance and virulence genes, pangenome.

methods.name: TORNADO-seq
methods.title: High-content, targeted RNA-seq screening in organoids for drug discovery in colorectal cancer
methods.summary: Targeted RNA-seq of large gene signatures for drug screens in intestinal organoids.

methods.name: totalVI
methods.title: Joint probabilistic modeling of single-cell multi-omic data with totalVI
methods.summary: Probabilistic framework for joint analysis of CITE-seq RNA and surface-protein data, modelling protein background and batch effects.

methods.name: tPBAT

methods.name: Trac-looping

methods.name: Trace-n-Seq
methods.title: Characterization of single neurons reprogrammed by pancreatic cancer

methods.name: TRACE-seq
methods.title: Transposase-assisted tagmentation of RNA/DNA hybrid duplexes

methods.name: TRACE-Seq (HSPC clonal tracking)

methods.name: TraCeR

methods.name: TrackSig

methods.name: TRACTION

methods.name: tradeSeq

methods.name: TraDIS

methods.name: TrAEL-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide analysis of DNA replication and DNA double-strand breaks using TrAEL-seq

methods.name: TrajectoryNet

methods.name: TrAnnoScope

methods.name: TransBind2

methods.name: TransCistor

methods.summary: Time-series RNA-seq analysis package covering mapping through differential expression and pathway analysis across time points.

methods.name: TRAPeS

methods.name: WebPrInSeS
methods.title: WebPrInSeS: automated full-length clone sequence identification and verification using high-throughput sequencing data
methods.summary: Web server that performs automated full-length clone sequence verification and positive-hit identification in clone libraries from high-throughput sequencing data via de novo assembly.

methods.name: Well-TEMP-seq
methods.title: Massively Parallel Profiling of Single-Cell RNA Dynamics Using Well-TEMP-seq
methods.summary: Protocol combining T-to-C metabolic RNA labelling with microwell-based single-cell RNA-seq to separate new from pre-existing transcripts in thousands of cells.

methods.name: wellDA-seq
methods.title: Single cell genome and epigenome co-profiling reveals hardwiring and plasticity in breast cancer
methods.summary: Dual-Tn5 tagmentation splits open and closed chromatin into ATAC and DNA libraries, with nanowell chip partitioning to co-profile copy number and accessibility in single cells.

methods.name: wellDR-seq
methods.title: Coalescing single-cell genomes and transcriptomes to decode breast cancer progression
methods.summary: Profiles genome and transcriptome from the same single cells at scale, allowing gene-dosage against expression analysis within subclones.

methods.name: Wellington
methods.title: Wellington: a novel method for the accurate identification of digital genomic footprints from DNase-seq data
methods.summary: DNase-seq footprinting algorithm that uses strand-specific read imbalance around protein-DNA interactions to identify occupied transcription factor binding sites, implemented in pyDNase.

methods.name: WemIQ
methods.full_name: weighted-log-likelihood expectation maximization method on isoform quantification
methods.title: WemIQ: an accurate and robust isoform quantification method for RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Isoform quantification for RNA-seq that removes read-sampling bias with a weighted EM algorithm and generalized Poisson bias model.

methods.name: WGBS
methods.children: arpeggio; cab-seq; chip-bs-seq; methyl-atac-seq; methyl-hic; nome-seq; oxbs-seq; scbs-seq; scimetv3; scsplat; scwgbs; splat; tab-seq; tacs; ubs-seq; umbs-seq
methods.title: Human DNA methylomes at base resolution show widespread epigenomic differences
methods.summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.

methods.name: wglrTAPS
methods.full_name: whole-genome long-read TET-assisted pyridine borane sequencing
methods.title: Whole-genome long-read TAPS deciphers DNA methylation patterns at base resolution using PacBio SMRT sequencing technology
methods.summary: TAPS chemistry combined with PacBio SMRT sequencing for whole-genome, base-resolution 5mC and 5hmC detection on long reads.

methods.name: WhatsHap Polyphase
methods.title: Haplotype threading: accurate polyploid phasing from long reads
methods.summary: Two-stage polyploid haplotype phasing from long reads that clusters reads and threads haplotypes through the clusters, implemented in WhatsHap.

methods.name: WHdenovo
methods.title: A haplotype-aware de novo assembly of related individuals using pedigree sequence graph
methods.summary: Pedigree sequence-graph assembler that builds haplotype-resolved diploid assemblies for all members of a family from Illumina and PacBio reads.

methods.name: WheresWalker
methods.title: Phenotype to genotype: A new and rapid approach using whole-genome sequencing
methods.summary: Mapping-by-sequencing algorithm that finds the mutation-containing interval in forward-genetic screens and supports positional cloning.

methods.name: WiggleTools
methods.title: WiggleTools: parallel processing of large collections of genome-wide datasets for visualization and statistical analysis
methods.summary: Multithreaded library that computes summary statistics across large collections of genome-wide signal tracks.

methods.name: Winnowmap
methods.title: Weighted minimizer sampling improves long read mapping
methods.summary: Long-read mapper using weighted minimizer sampling that down-weights frequent k-mers to improve mapping in repetitive regions.

methods.name: WinPCA
methods.title: WinPCA: a package for windowed principal component analysis
methods.summary: Package that computes, polarises and visualises genetic principal components in windows along the genome.

methods.name: Wreath
methods.title: A framework for genome-wide characterization of DNA methylation and variant effect prediction
methods.summary: Deep-learning sequence model that predicts the context-dependent effect of genetic variants on DNA methylation, within a genome-wide methylation-class framework.

methods.name: Write-and-Read
methods.title: Write and Read: Harnessing Synthetic DNA Modifications for Nanopore Sequencing
methods.summary: Chemo-enzymatic DNA labelling with synthetic tags (e.g. glucose or azide on 5-hydroxymethylcytosine or adenine) that produces distinct, reproducible nanopore current shifts read directly from native DNA.

methods.name: X-CODE
methods.title: X-CODE: a dual RNA barcoding system for multi-platform clonal tracking and spatial phenotyping
methods.summary: Dual-expressed RNA barcode with a probe-detectable long barcode and a matched short sequencing barcode for clonal tracking across imaging, cytometry and sequencing.

methods.name: X-SPEAR
methods.title: X-SPEAR: An Extensible Framework for Spatial Panel Evaluation and Refinement
methods.summary: Framework that selects targeted spatial transcriptomics gene panels with DART Boolean gene rules trained on detection-aware reference data, plus probe-level off-target assessment.

methods.name: XChrom
methods.title: XChrom: A Cross-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Prediction Model Integrating Genomic Sequence and Cellular Context
methods.summary: Deep-learning model that predicts genome-wide chromatin accessibility in unseen cells from DNA sequence and single-cell transcriptome-derived cell identity.

methods.name: XClone
methods.title: Robust analysis of allele-specific copy number alterations from scRNA-seq data with XClone
methods.summary: Statistical method that detects haplotype-aware copy number alterations from scRNA-seq using neighbourhood and gene-graph smoothing.

methods.name: XDec-SM
methods.title: Deconvolution of cancer cell states by the XDec-SM method
methods.summary: Reference-optional deconvolution of bulk RNA-seq tumour profiles that maps tumours and constituent cell states onto a low-dimensional space.

methods.name: Ximmer
methods.title: Ximmer: a system for improving accuracy and consistency of CNV calling from exome data.
methods.summary: End-to-end system for evaluating, tuning and running exome CNV callers, with simulation and curation tools.

methods.name: XL-DNase-seq
methods.title: XL-DNase-seq: improved footprinting of dynamic transcription factors
methods.summary: DNase-seq with mild cross-linking that improves footprints of dynamic transcription factors.

methods.name: xMD-miRNA-seq
methods.full_name: expression microdissection miRNA small RNA sequencing
methods.title: xMD-miRNA-seq to generate near in vivo miRNA expression estimates in colon epithelial cells
methods.summary: Expression microdissection of specific cell types from FFPE tissue followed by low-input small RNA-seq to estimate in vivo miRNA expression.

methods.name: XpBrew
methods.title: XpBrew and PanXpresso - automatic RNA-seq processing workflow and comprehensive collection of gene expression data
methods.summary: End-to-end Python workflow for automated RNA-seq processing across plants, animals, fungi, bacteria and archaea, used to build the PanXpresso collection.

methods.name: XplainTDA
methods.title: XplainTDA: Explaining the topological structure of single-cell multi-omics data through perturbation
methods.summary: Explainable topological data analysis framework that uses perturbation to identify the molecular determinants of persistent-homology structure in single-cell data.

methods.name: Xpresso
methods.title: Predicting mRNA Abundance Directly from Genomic Sequence Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks.
methods.summary: Convolutional neural network that predicts steady-state mRNA levels from promoter sequence and mRNA-stability features.

methods.name: XPRESSyourself
methods.title: XPRESSyourself: Enhancing, standardizing, and automating ribosome profiling computational analyses yields improved insight into data.
methods.summary: Open-source toolkit that automates and standardises ribosome profiling analysis workflows.

methods.name: XR-seq
methods.title: Genome-wide analysis of human global and transcription-coupled excision repair of UV damage at single-nucleotide resolution
methods.summary: Isolates the ~30-mer excision fragments released when UV lesions are repaired and sequences them to map global and transcription-coupled repair at nucleotide resolution.

methods.name: Xrare
methods.title: Xrare: a machine learning method jointly modeling phenotypes and genetic evidence for rare disease diagnosis
methods.summary: Machine-learning model combining phenotype similarity (ERIC) and genetic features to prioritise causative variants in rare disease.

methods.name: XRBS
methods.title: Extended-representation bisulfite sequencing of gene regulatory elements in multiplexed samples and single cells
methods.summary: Reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing extended to cover regulatory elements (promoters, enhancers, CTCF sites), with barcoding before conversion for multiplexing and single-cell use.

methods.name: xseq
methods.title: Systematic analysis of somatic mutations impacting gene expression in 12 tumour types
methods.summary: Hierarchical Bayes model that quantifies the impact of somatic mutations on expression profiles, applied to TCGA tumour data sets.

methods.name: xTea
methods.title: Comprehensive identification of transposable element insertions using multiple sequencing technologies
methods.summary: Tool that identifies transposable element insertions from short-read and long-read whole-genome sequencing data.

methods.name: XYZeq
methods.title: XYZeq: Spatially resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals expression heterogeneity in the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Spatially barcoded single-cell RNA-seq workflow that encodes tissue-position metadata into scRNA-seq libraries.

methods.name: Y-LineageTracker
methods.title: Y-LineageTracker: a high-throughput analysis framework for Y-chromosomal next-generation sequencing data
methods.summary: Framework for Y-chromosome haplogroup assignment, Y-STR analysis and paternal lineage inference from NGS data.

methods.name: Y2H-seq
methods.title: A Y2H-seq approach defines the human protein methyltransferase interactome
methods.summary: Yeast two-hybrid interaction screening read out by short-read sequencing with a quantitative scoring readout, used to map the human protein methyltransferase interactome.

methods.name: YaHS
methods.title: YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool
methods.summary: Command-line Hi-C scaffolding tool that builds chromosome-scale scaffolds from an assembly and an alignment file.

methods.name: YAMAT-seq
methods.title: YAMAT-seq: an efficient method for high-throughput sequencing of mature transfer RNAs
methods.summary: Y-shaped adapter ligation with T4 RNA ligase 2 to mature tRNAs, then cDNA amplification, for efficient high-throughput tRNA sequencing.

methods.name: yeastDrop-Seq
methods.title: A yeast-optimized single-cell transcriptomics platform elucidates how mycophenolic acid and guanine alter global mRNA levels
methods.summary: Drop-seq variant optimised for yeast cells to count mRNA molecules per individual cell.

methods.name: YETI
methods.title: Interpretation of an individual functional genomics experiment guided by massive public data
methods.summary: Builds tailored functional interaction maps from public functional genomics data to interpret an individual omics experiment.

methods.name: yscRNA-seq
methods.title: Sensitive high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq reveals within-clonal transcript correlations in yeast populations
methods.summary: Strand-specific single-cell RNA-seq for yeast that counts transcript start sites, paired with index sorting to relate RNA content to cell size.

methods.name: ZCNT
methods.title: A zero-agnostic model for copy number evolution in cancer
methods.summary: Copy-number phylogeny model that allows amplification or deletion of regions with zero copies, with a closed-form distance.

methods.name: ZEN
methods.title: Zone equalisation normalisation for improved alignment of epigenetic signal
methods.summary: Normalisation that rescales genomic signal by variance within enriched regions to align replicates and samples.

methods.name: ZINB-WaVE
methods.title: A general and flexible method for signal extraction from single-cell RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Zero-inflated negative binomial model giving low-dimensional scRNA-seq representations that account for dropouts and batch effects.

methods.name: zingeR
methods.title: zingeR: unlocking RNA-seq tools for zero-inflation and single cell applications
methods.summary: Observation-weight method that makes bulk RNA-seq differential expression tools robust to zero inflation in single-cell data.

methods.name: ZipSeq
methods.title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
methods.summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.

methods.name: Zman-seq
methods.title: Time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics defines immune trajectories in glioblastoma
methods.summary: Single-cell transcriptomics with time stamps written into circulating immune cells, so their state changes can be tracked in tissue over days.

methods.name: ZymoR
methods.title: ZymoR: Bridging plant pathology and automated bioinformatics for fungicide resistance profiling in Zymoseptoria tritici
methods.summary: Automated bioinformatics platform for detecting fungicide-resistance mutations and CYP51 haplotypes in Zymoseptoria tritici high-throughput sequencing data.

methods.name: μ-cisTarget
methods.title: Identification of cis-regulatory mutations generating de novo edges in personalized cancer gene regulatory networks
methods.summary: Filters, annotates and prioritises cis-regulatory mutations by their predicted effect on a personal gene regulatory network.

methods.name: μChIP-seq (Dahl 2016)
methods.title: Broad histone H3K4me3 domains in mouse oocytes modulate maternal-to-zygotic transition
methods.summary: Micro-scale ChIP-seq that profiles histone H3 lysine methylation and acetylation from very few cells, used on mouse oocytes and early embryos.
